segments.name: Modular Space Solutions and Portable Storage
segments.description: Leases and sells turnkey temporary modular space and portable storage solutions to customers across diverse end markets.
segments.evidence: Our diverse product offering includes modular office complexes, mobile offices, classrooms, blast-resistant modules, clearspan structures, sanitation solutions, portable storage containers, and climate-controlled containers and trailers.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay lease rental fees for temporary modular space and portable storage units on an outsourced basis, plus fees for delivery, installation, maintenance, and value-added products.
revenueModel.evidence: We lease turnkey space solutions (our "lease fleet") to customers across 15 distinct end markets.

changes.text: In January 2023, the Company sold its United Kingdom Storage Solutions segment and presented the historical financial results as discontinued operations.
changes.evidence: On January 31, 2023, the Company completed the sale of our former United Kingdom Storage Solutions ("UK Storage Solutions") segment.
